Original result/source/session/raw reports and previous regrade history remain unchanged. Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.

payload.editorial_summary: Completed voluntarily; unchanged source passes 223/223 after LAS 2.0.3 fixture and representation repairs. Original grade: 184/219 under 2.0.1.
payload.notes: Full transcript, retained source and all original failures reviewed. The original 35 failures were caused by invalid shared waveform offsets and unspecified JSON representation expectations, not missing implementation. Corrected tests preserve all model-visible input and add four interval rejection cases; this unchanged source passes all 223 cases in the pinned offline Docker grader. The model built the C++20 implementation, passed 261 self-checks and sanitizer runs, and completed voluntarily. Original result, source, reasoning tokens, input/cache/output counts, tool calls and estimated generation cost are retained. Regrading made zero model calls and added no model cost. Passing this suite does not prove exhaustive LAS conformance. That earlier local publication is preserved in the new audit before replacement.
